description: paged.net hosts static websites and keeps each upload as a version that can be published or restored later. Site owners can create, publish, inspect, and manage their own sites through the web app, REST API, or MCP server.
summary: paged.net exposes two public developer integration surfaces on its own domain: a versioned owner REST API at `https://paged.net/api/v1` and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at `https://paged.net/api/mcp` over streamable HTTP.
